levels.label: Local pilot
levels.allowed_claim: The W1 pilot binds a human hypothesis to a declared command and exports a local continuation receipt.
levels.forbidden_inference: The pilot is a hosted incident platform or an AI-agent requirement.

levels.label: Bounded action
levels.allowed_claim: The fixture command is previewed as read-only and requires explicit human authorization before execution.
levels.forbidden_inference: Every repository command or mutation is automatically safe.

levels.label: Receipt continuity
levels.allowed_claim: The local receipt preserves a passed result, bounded redacted excerpt, output hash, target identity, omission, disposition, and rerun interface.
levels.forbidden_inference: The bounded excerpt is the complete command output or a cross-machine handoff proof.

levels.label: Binary preview
levels.allowed_claim: The candidate packet includes a crop-safe 1600 × 900 PNG preview whose hypothesis, bounded command, outcome, and continuation line remain legible.
levels.forbidden_inference: A polished preview proves direct IDE continuity or a hosted case page.

levels.label: Direct IDE continuity
levels.allowed_claim: The repository contains a thin VS Code command surface that still needs direct continuity readback.
levels.forbidden_inference: An inheritor has resumed the trail through an installed VS Code host.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Deployment and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The case is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
